sections.title: Outcomes, not offerings
sections.subtitle: Five strategic value plays that combine our services, Linkfields software and reusable accelerators to deliver measurable business outcomes.

sections.heading: Start with your requirements
sections.body: Each play starts with a customer trigger and an intended business outcome. Combine the relevant service portfolios, Linkfields software and reusable delivery IP around your requirements. Explore a play to see how an engagement can run, what evidence it can produce and which commercial models may fit.

sections.heading: What would you like to achieve?

items.title: AI Code Assurance
items.description: AI-generated code increases delivery speed and assurance risk.
items.bullets: Intended outcome - Ship AI-written change with visible quality and security evidence.

items.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
items.description: Complex migration and customisation create regression and integration risk.
items.footText: Linkworks, Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, testoriumz, Release Assurance Packs
items.bullets: Intended outcome - Validate migration readiness and release quality before critical cutovers.

items.title: Regulated Cyber Readiness
items.description: Regulated industries need continuous evidence, not point-in-time reports.
items.bullets: Intended outcome - Maintain evidence of exposures, control gaps and remediation progress.

items.title: Intelligent Operations
items.description: Cost-to-serve pressure creates demand for process intelligence and automation.
items.footText: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery
items.bullets: Intended outcome - Reduce avoidable hand-offs and make process performance visible.

items.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
items.description: Organisations need scalable delivery capacity with stronger governance and automation.
items.footText: Linkworks, Delivery Governance, Quality Engineering IP, Cyber-Safe Delivery
items.bullets: Intended outcome - Build governed delivery capacity with a clear path to capability transfer.

sections.description: Choose the trigger closest to your priorities. Each play has its own delivery pattern, IP mapping and discussion route.

sections.heading: What sits behind each play

items.title: Specialist service portfolios
items.description: The five portfolios provide engineering, platform, data, security and capability-centre expertise. Select the lead and supporting disciplines for the outcome.

items.title: Linkfields software
items.description: Proprietary products support specific parts of the solution: composable applications, continuous quality engineering and exposure validation.

items.title: Reusable delivery IP
items.description: Modernisation, integration, regression, quality, security and governance accelerators are tailored to the scope and acceptance criteria.

sections.description: Services deliver the change. Products provide software capabilities. Accelerators provide reusable delivery IP; the mix is agreed for the engagement.
sections.note: For programme assurance, Digital Transformation leads custom application and integration work, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms connects the core migration, and Cyber Security validates release risks. Linkworks and testoriumz support the agreed engineering and assurance scope.

sections.heading: Choose the commercial basis

items.title: Fixed Price
items.description: Defined scope, milestones and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Time & Materials
items.description: Evolving scope, transparent rates and delivery governance.

items.title: Managed Service
items.description: Ongoing service, agreed SLAs and continuous improvement.

items.title: Dedicated Team
items.description: Persistent squads aligned to your priorities and ways of working.

items.title: Outcome-Based
items.description: Measurable outcomes, where the baseline and evidence can be agreed.

sections.description: Buy a project, a managed outcome, a dedicated team or software on its own.
sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Product-specific terms and delivery scope are agreed separately.
